name: Jonny B.
text: My home was in need of a new paint job badly. Ivan and his team came in and did an amazing job. Their attention to detail was amazing. They were very efficient and clean. I would definitely recommend them to my friends.

name: Elena F.
text: I used Painters Touch for my entire apartment. I would never use anyone else. From the first consultation with Ivan, he explained the entire process and time frame. I had popcorn ceilings throughout and Jose and his team were able to skim coat and the result was unbelievable, so beautiful. Ivan even had a camera which could take pictures of an item and recommend a color to coordinate. Jose’s team were excellent and professional and friendly. I was kept informed of the progress because I was staying elsewhere during the project. Ivan was always available for any question I may have had during the project. I can highly recommend Painters Touch for your painting needs. You won’t be disappointed.

name: Brad W.
text: Ivan and his team painted my whole apt. I would highly recommend them. This company is very professional, they do the job on a timely basis, the work is impeccable and they are very careful not to damage floors or anything in your apt. I am very happy to have hired them. You will not regret using them to work on your house or apt.

name: Krysten B.
text: Ivan did an amazing job repainting our entire apartment, including the ceilings. Below is just one photo but I can confidently say each room came out just as amazing as this one. He also helped us out with tricky bathroom ceilings as well. He was neat and efficient and we would definitely use him again going forward!

name: Gerardo U.
text: Fantastic work, amazing attention to detail! Would hire again
